long.title: US Citizenship Test 2026: Civics Test Practice Questions with Answers (50 Questions)
long.description:
US citizenship test 2026 practice: 50 civics test questions with answers, a 5-second timer and every answer explained. Ideal for your N-400 naturalization interview. Pause any time if you need more time.

In the 2025 civics test (for N-400s filed on or after 20 October 2025), the USCIS officer asks up to 20 questions out of 128, and you need 12 correct to pass.

▶ Free timed US citizenship practice tests: https://mocknight.online
▶ Official USCIS study materials: https://www.uscis.gov/citizenship

CHAPTERS
0:00 Intro
0:06 Principles of American government
1:18 System of government
4:05 Rights and responsibilities
4:41 Colonial period and independence
5:44 The 1800s
6:29 Recent American history
7:05 Symbols and holidays
7:41 Your score + where to practise

What did you score out of 50? Tell us in the comments and subscribe for more citizenship test practice.

Mock Night is an independent study tool, not affiliated with any government or exam body.
